user.title: Sign in to MyAccount
user.description: Enter your Yarra Valley Water MyAccount details. They are used once to sign in and are not stored — only the resulting session is kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The MyAccount session has expired. Sign in again to resume collecting water usage.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.description: Yarra Valley Water has sent a {digits}-digit verification code to your phone. Each code can only be used once, so use the most recent message. If it has not arrived, tick 'Send a new code' and submit to have another one sent. {detail}

site.title: Choose a property
site.description: Select the property whose water use you want to follow.

account.title: Which account?
account.description: Your water account number could not be read automatically. It is the 10-digit number on your Yarra Valley Water bill, and is shown at the top of the portal next to your address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Yarra Valley Water portal.
error.invalid_auth: That email address or password was not accepted.
error.invalid_code: That verification code was not accepted. Codes can only be used once, so check you are using the newest message, or request a new code.
error.unknown: Something went wrong signing in. Check the logs for details.
error.code_required: Enter the verification code, or tick 'Send a new code'.
error.code_resent: A new code has been sent. Enter it below.
error.invalid_account: Enter the account number as digits.
error.unknown_account: The portal did not recognise that account number for this login.

abort.already_configured: This water account is already set up.
abort.no_account: Signed in, but no water account could be read from the portal.
abort.no_meter: This account has no digital meter, so there is no hourly usage to collect.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different water account.

init.title: Yarra Valley Water options
init.description:
How often to touch the portal so the sign-in session does not lapse. Lower is safer but talks to Yarra Valley Water more often; higher is quieter but risks the session expiring, which needs a new SMS code.

Finding the timeout stretches the interval a step at a time until a session does lapse, which brackets the real limit. It ends by costing one verification code, then settles on a safe interval and switches itself off.

Including the session in diagnostics puts your live sign-in in that file in the clear, so anyone who reads it can use your account until the session lapses. Leave it off unless someone is helping you debug, and never post such a file publicly.

{findings}

data.probe_step_minutes: Increase by, each time it survives
